name: Topotecan (single agent)

institution.provenance: StewardMD DRAFT single-agent option authored in-house from standard-of-care oncology; experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: Low-to-moderate emetogenic; give per emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: Myelosuppression (especially neutropenia and thrombocytopenia) is the dose-limiting toxicity: reduce dose for prior grade 4 counts and consider growth-factor support.
Reduce dose in renal impairment per package insert (topotecan is renally cleared).
monitoring: CBC before each dose and mid-cycle if using the 5-day schedule

drugs.name: Topotecan
drugs.notes: Topotecan 1.5 mg/m2 IV on days 1-5 every 21 days for recurrent ovarian cancer (a weekly 4 mg/m2 schedule on days 1, 8, 15 is a better-tolerated alternative). Dose-reduce for cytopenias and renal impairment per package insert. Authored in StewardMD's words from standard-of-care oncology (NCCN/DeVita general reference).
